exposure: vaginal delivery of a previous macrosomic neonate
outcome: Rate of shoulder dystocia (SD) in the subsequent pregnancy
cohort: 38,942 women with a singleton pregnancy and two consecutive deliveries
finding: Previous uneventful delivery of a macrosomic neonate to a non-diabetic mother should not be regarded as a risk factor for SD in the subsequent delivery.
mod_finding: Previous uneventful vaginal delivery of a macrosomic neonate to a non-diabetic mother was not found to be a risk factor for shoulder dystocia in the subsequent delivery.
birth_weight: Neonate birthweight recorded as ≥ 4000g (macrosomic) or not
